questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how runPayroll's per-employee loop scales with company size? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
An hourly employee at $20/hour works 45 hours in week A and 30 hours in week B of the same pay period. What gross pay does grossCents compute?
choices: $1,500, since 75 hours across the period is under 80 so no overtime applies
$1,550, with overtime on the 5 hours over 40 in week A
$1,600, because overtime is paid at double time
$1,650, with overtime applied to all 45 hours of week A

questions.prompt: Bands are [0-1,000,000 at 10%, 1,000,000-open at 20%] (in cents). What withholding is computed for a gross of 1,500,000 cents?
choices: 200,000 cents: 100,000 from the first band plus 100,000 from the second

questions.prompt: An employee's region has no entry in bandsByRegion. What does runPayroll do?
choices: Uses zero withholding for that employee and continues
Uses the bands of the first region in the map
Throws, so no payslips are returned for the whole run
